// Historical reproduction harness; living CI coverage: ../../lipgloss_writer_compat_test.go.
// Frozen for the original measurements; changes to living tests need not be copied here.
package lipgloss

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi"
)

// legacyWrapWriter is the v2.0.6 byte-forwarding implementation, retained only
// as an output and benchmark oracle for the upstream batching experiment.
type legacyWrapWriter struct{ *WrapWriter }

func (w *legacyWrapWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if w.p == nil {
		return len(p), nil
	}
	for _, b := range p {
		w.p.Advance(b)
		if b == '\n' {
			if !w.style.IsZero() {
				_, _ = w.w.Write([]byte(ansi.ResetStyle))
			}
			if !w.link.IsZero() {
				_, _ = w.w.Write([]byte(ansi.ResetHyperlink()))
			}
		}
		_, _ = w.w.Write([]byte{b})
		if b == '\n' {
			if !w.link.IsZero() {
				_, _ = w.w.Write([]byte(ansi.SetHyperlink(w.link.URL, w.link.Params)))
			}
			if !w.style.IsZero() {
				_, _ = w.w.Write([]byte(w.style.String()))
			}
		}
	}
	return len(p), nil
}

func wrapChain(dst io.Writer, depth int, legacy bool) (io.Writer, []io.Closer) {
	var closers []io.Closer
	for range depth {
		w := NewWrapWriter(dst)
		if legacy {
			dst = &legacyWrapWriter{w}
		} else {
			dst = w
		}
		closers = append(closers, dst.(io.Closer))
	}
	return dst, closers
}

func renderChain(t *testing.T, input string, split, depth int, legacy bool) string {
	t.Helper()
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	w, closers := wrapChain(&buf, depth, legacy)
	for _, part := range []string{input[:split], input[split:]} {
		n, err := w.Write([]byte(part))
		if err != nil || n != len(part) {
			t.Fatalf("write: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
		}
	}
	for i := len(closers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if err := closers[i].Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if n, err := w.Write([]byte("after close")); n != 11 || err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write after close: n=%d err=%v", n, err)
	}
	return buf.String()
}

func TestWrapBatchCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
	inputs := []string{
		"", "plain café 界 e\u0301", "\n\n", "first\nsecond\n",
		"\x1b[1mfirst\nsecond\x1b[0m\n",
		ansi.SetHyperlink("https://example.com", "id=fixture") + "one\ntwo" + ansi.ResetHyperlink(),
		"\x1b[1m" + ansi.SetHyperlink("https://example.com", "") + "café 界\nnext\n" + ansi.ResetHyperlink() + "\x1b[0m",
		"\x1b[1mone\x1b[0m\nplain",
		"\x1b[1m", "\x1b[", "\x1b]8;;https://example.com",
	}
	for _, input := range inputs {
		for depth := 1; depth <= 3; depth++ {
			for split := 0; split <= len(input); split++ {
				want := renderChain(t, input, split, depth, true)
				got := renderChain(t, input, split, depth, false)
				if got != want {
					t.Fatalf("depth=%d split=%d input=%q\ngot %q\nwant %q", depth, split, input, got, want)
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

type countingWriter struct{ calls int }

func (w *countingWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	w.calls++
	return len(p), nil
}

func TestWrapBatchWriteCalls(t *testing.T) {
	var dst countingWriter
	w := NewWrapWriter(&dst)
	_, _ = w.Write([]byte("one\ntwo\nthree"))
	_ = w.Close()
	if dst.calls != 5 { // three runs, two newline writes
		t.Fatalf("downstream writes = %d, want 5", dst.calls)
	}
}

func BenchmarkWrapBatch(b *testing.B) {
	input := []byte(strings.Repeat("\x1b[1mThe café 界 service is ready.\nNext line.\x1b[0m\n", 200))
	for _, legacy := range []bool{true, false} {
		name := "batched"
		if legacy {
			name = "legacy"
		}
		b.Run(name, func(b *testing.B) {
			b.SetBytes(int64(len(input)))
			b.ReportAllocs()
			for b.Loop() {
				w, closers := wrapChain(io.Discard, 3, legacy)
				_, _ = w.Write(input)
				for i := len(closers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
					_ = closers[i].Close()
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
